name: Hubei Wanrun New Energy Technology Co.,Ltd.
summary: Hubei Wanrun New Energy Technology Co.,Ltd. engages in the manufacturing and selling of the cathode materials and precursors for lithium-ion power batteries and energy storage batteries in China and internationally. The company offers raw material development, power battery, energy storage batteries, zero wastewater discharge, and photovoltaic-storage charging swap solutions. It provides products and services for the Lithium Iron Phosphate, Lithium Manganese Iron Phosphate, Sodium-Ion Battery Materials, Lithium Iron Oxide Rich in Lithium, Hard Carbon Anod applications. Hubei Wanrun New Energy Technology Co.,Ltd. was incorporated in 2010 and is based in Shiyan, China.
